details.original_question: How many schools with an average score in Math greater than 400 in the SAT test are exclusively virtual?
details.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.School) FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.Virtual = 'F' AND T1.AvgScrMath > 400

details.original_question: Please list the codes of the schools with a total enrollment of over 500.
details.gold_sql: SELECT T2.CDSCode FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.`Enrollment (K-12)` + T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 500

details.original_question: Among the schools with an SAT excellence rate of over 0.3, what is the highest eligible free rate for students aged 5-17?
details.gold_sql: SELECT MAX(CAST(T1.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` AS REAL) / T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds WHERE CAST(T2.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / T2.NumTstTakr > 0.3

details.original_question: Rank schools by their average score in Writing where the score is greater than 499, showing their charter numbers.
details.gold_sql: SELECT CharterNum, AvgScrWrite, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AvgScrWrite DESC) AS WritingScoreRank FROM schools AS T1  INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds WHERE T2.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND CharterNum is not null

details.original_question: List the names of schools with more than 30 difference in enrollements between K-12 and ages 5-17? Please also give the full street adress of the schools.
details.gold_sql: SELECT T1.School, T1.Street FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 30

details.original_question: Which are the cards that have incredibly powerful foils.
details.gold_sql: SELECT id FROM cards WHERE cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL

details.original_question: What are the borderless cards available without powerful foils?
details.gold_sql: SELECT id FROM cards WHERE borderColor = 'borderless' AND (cardKingdomId IS NULL OR cardKingdomId IS NULL)

details.original_question: List all the mythic rarity print cards banned in gladiator format.
details.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.id FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T2.format = 'gladiator' AND T2.status = 'Banned' AND T1.rarity = 'mythic'

details.original_question: For artifact type of cards that do not have multiple faces on the same card, state its legalities status for vintage play format.
details.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T2.status FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.type = 'Artifact' AND T2.format = 'vintage' AND T1.side IS NULL

details.original_question: List all the card id and artist with unknown power which are legal for commander play format.
details.gold_sql: SELECT T1.id, T1.artist FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T2.status = 'Legal' AND T2.format = 'commander' AND (T1.power IS NULL OR T1.power = '*')

details.original_question: Which user has a higher reputation, Harlan or Jarrod Dixon?
details.gold_sql: SELECT DisplayName FROM users WHERE DisplayName IN ('Harlan', 'Jarrod Dixon') AND Reputation = ( SELECT MAX(Reputation) FROM users WHERE DisplayName IN ('Harlan', 'Jarrod Dixon') )

details.original_question: Please list the display names of all the users whose accounts were created in the year 2011.
details.gold_sql: SELECT DisplayName FROM users WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', CreationDate) = '2011'

details.original_question: How many users last accessed the website after 2014/9/1?
details.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(Id) FROM users WHERE date(LastAccessDate) > '2014-09-01'

details.original_question: Who is the owner of the post "Eliciting priors from experts"?
details.gold_sql: SELECT T2.DisplayName FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id WHERE T1.Title = 'Eliciting priors from experts'

details.original_question: How many posts does the user csgillespie own?
details.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id WHERE T2.DisplayName = 'csgillespie'

details.original_question: Give the name of the league had the most goals in the 2016 season?
details.gold_sql: SELECT t2.name FROM Match AS t1 INNER JOIN League AS t2 ON t1.league_id = t2.id WHERE t1.season = '2015/2016' GROUP BY t2.name ORDER BY SUM(t1.home_team_goal + t1.away_team_goal) DESC LIMIT 1

details.original_question: In Scotland Premier League, which away team won the most during the 2010 season?
details.gold_sql: SELECT teamInfo.team_long_name FROM League AS leagueData INNER JOIN Match AS matchData ON leagueData.id = matchData.league_id INNER JOIN Team AS teamInfo ON matchData.away_team_api_id = teamInfo.team_api_id WHERE leagueData.name = 'Scotland Premier League' AND matchData.season = '2009/2010' AND matchData.away_team_goal - matchData.home_team_goal > 0 GROUP BY matchData.away_team_api_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

details.original_question: What are the speed in which attacks are put together of the top 4 teams with the highest build Up Play Speed?
details.gold_sql: SELECT t1.buildUpPlaySpeed FROM Team_Attributes AS t1 INNER JOIN Team AS t2 ON t1.team_api_id = t2.team_api_id ORDER BY t1.buildUpPlaySpeed ASC LIMIT 4

details.original_question: Give the name of the league had the most matches end as draw in the 2016 season?
details.gold_sql: SELECT t2.name FROM Match AS t1 INNER JOIN League AS t2 ON t1.league_id = t2.id WHERE t1.season = '2015/2016' AND t1.home_team_goal = t1.away_team_goal GROUP BY t2.name ORDER BY COUNT(t1.id) DESC LIMIT 1

details.original_question: At present, calculate for the player's age who have a sprint speed of no less than 97 between 2013 to 2015.
details.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT DATETIME() - T2.birthday age FROM Player_Attributes AS t1 INNER JOIN Player AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id WHERE STRFTIME('%Y',t1.`date`) >= '2013' AND STRFTIME('%Y',t1.`date`) <= '2015' AND t1.sprint_speed >= 97

details.original_question: How many accounts who choose issuance after transaction are staying in East Bohemia region?
details.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(T2.account_id) FROM district AS T1 INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE T1.A3 = 'east Bohemia' AND T2.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'

details.original_question: List out the no. of districts that have female average salary is more than 6000 but less than 10000?
details.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.district_id)  FROM client AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE T1.gender = 'F' AND T2.A11 BETWEEN 6000 AND 10000

details.original_question: How many male customers who are living in North Bohemia have average salary greater than 8000?
details.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.client_id) FROM client AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE T1.gender = 'M' AND T2.A3 = 'north Bohemia' AND T2.A11 > 8000

details.original_question: List out the account numbers of female clients who are oldest and has lowest average salary, calculate the gap between this lowest average salary with the highest average salary?
details.gold_sql: SELECT T1.account_id , ( SELECT MAX(A11) - MIN(A11) FROM district ) FROM account AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id INNER JOIN disp AS T3 ON T1.account_id = T3.account_id INNER JOIN client AS T4 ON T3.client_id = T4.client_id WHERE T2.district_id = ( SELECT district_id FROM client WHERE gender = 'F' ORDER BY birth_date ASC LIMIT 1 ) ORDER BY T2.A11 DESC LIMIT 1

details.original_question: List out the account numbers of clients who are youngest and have highest average salary?
details.gold_sql: SELECT T1.account_id  FROM account AS T1 INNER JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id INNER JOIN client AS T3 ON T2.client_id = T3.client_id INNER JOIN district AS T4 on T4.district_id = T1.district_id WHERE T2.client_id = ( SELECT client_id FROM client ORDER BY birth_date DESC LIMIT 1) GROUP BY T4.A11, T1.account_id

details.original_question: Please list the reference names of the drivers who are eliminated in the first period in race number 20.
details.gold_sql: SELECT T2.driverRef FROM qualifying AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId WHERE T1.raceId = 20 ORDER BY T1.q1 DESC LIMIT 5

details.original_question: What is the surname of the driver with the best lap time in race number 19 in the second qualifying period?
details.gold_sql: SELECT T2.surname FROM qualifying AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId WHERE T1.raceId = 19 ORDER BY T1.q2 ASC LIMIT 1

details.original_question: Please give the name of the race held on the circuits in Germany.
details.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T2.name FROM circuits AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T2.circuitID = T1.circuitId WHERE T1.country = 'Germany'

details.original_question: What is the coordinates location of the circuits for Australian grand prix?
details.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.lat, T1.lng FROM circuits AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T2.circuitID = T1.circuitId WHERE T2.name = 'Australian Grand Prix'

details.original_question: Give the coordinate position for Abu Dhabi Grand Prix.
details.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.lat, T1.lng FROM circuits AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T2.circuitID = T1.circuitId WHERE T2.name = 'Abu Dhabi Grand Prix'

details.original_question: How many members attended the "Women's Soccer" event?
details.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(T2.link_to_member) FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event WHERE T1.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer'

details.original_question: List all the members of the "School of Applied Sciences, Technology and Education" department.
details.gold_sql: SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN major AS T2 ON T1.link_to_major = T2.major_id WHERE T2.department = 'School of Applied Sciences, Technology and Education'

details.original_question: Among all the closed events, which event has the highest spend-to-budget ratio?
details.gold_sql: SELECT T2.event_name FROM budget AS T1 INNER JOIN event AS T2 ON T1.link_to_event = T2.event_id WHERE T2.status = 'Closed' ORDER BY T1.spent / T1.amount DESC LIMIT 1

details.original_question: What is the highest amount of budget spend for an event?
details.gold_sql: SELECT MAX(spent) FROM budget

details.original_question: What is the total amount of money spent for food?
details.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(spent) FROM budget WHERE category = 'Food'

details.original_question: Please list all the superpowers of 3-D Man.
details.gold_sql: SELECT T3.power_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id WHERE T1.superhero_name = '3-D Man'

details.original_question: Among the superheroes with the super power of "Super Strength", how many of them have a height of over 200cm?
details.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id WHERE T3.power_name = 'Super Strength' AND T1.height_cm > 200

details.original_question: Among the superheroes with blue eyes, how many of them have the super power of "Agility"?
details.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id INNER JOIN colour AS T4 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T4.id WHERE T3.power_name = 'Agility' AND T4.colour = 'Blue'

details.original_question: Please list the superhero names of all the superheroes that have blue eyes and blond hair.
details.gold_sql: SELECT T1.superhero_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id INNER JOIN colour AS T3 ON T1.hair_colour_id = T3.id WHERE T2.colour = 'Blue' AND T3.colour = 'Blond'

details.original_question: Rank heroes published by Marvel Comics by their height in descending order.
details.gold_sql: SELECT superhero_name, height_cm, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY height_cm DESC) AS HeightRank FROM superhero INNER JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'

details.original_question: Are there more in-patient or outpatient who were male? What is the deviation in percentage?
details.gold_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'M'

details.original_question: What is the percentage of female patient were born after 1930?
details.gold_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', Birthday) > '1930' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F'

details.original_question: What is the ratio of outpatient to inpatient followed up treatment among all the 'SLE' diagnosed patient?
details.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM Patient WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'

details.original_question: What is the disease patient '30609' diagnosed with. List all the date of laboratory tests done for this patient.
details.gold_sql: SELECT T1.Diagnosis, T2.Date FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.ID = 30609

details.original_question: List the patient ID, sex and birthday of patient with LDH beyond normal range.
details.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Birthday FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.LDH > 500

details.original_question: What is the most common bond type?
details.gold_sql: SELECT T.bond_type FROM ( SELECT bond_type, COUNT(bond_id) FROM bond GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY COUNT(bond_id) DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS T

details.original_question: Calculate the average number of oxygen atoms in single-bonded molecules.
details.gold_sql: SELECT AVG(oxygen_count) FROM (SELECT T1.molecule_id, COUNT(T1.element) AS oxygen_count FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id  WHERE T2.bond_type = '-' AND T1.element = 'o'  GROUP BY T1.molecule_id) AS oxygen_counts

details.original_question: On average how many carcinogenic molecules are single bonded?
details.gold_sql: SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) FROM (SELECT T3.molecule_id, COUNT(T1.bond_type) AS single_bond_count FROM bond AS T1  INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id INNER JOIN molecule AS T3 ON T3.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.bond_type = '-' AND T3.label = '+' GROUP BY T3.molecule_id) AS subquery

details.original_question: Find the triple-bonded molecules which are carcinogenic.
details.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T2.molecule_id FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.bond_type = '#' AND T2.label = '+'

details.original_question: What is the percentage of carbon in double-bond molecules?
details.gold_sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T1.element = 'c' THEN T1.atom_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT T1.atom_id) FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.bond_type = '='
